responsibility: Provides the out-of-line shared implementations for the Rust frontend’s full AST model that are inconvenient to keep inline in the headers, rather than defining a separate subsystem of nodes. In particular it implements many `as_string` debug/rendering methods for crate, attribute, token-tree, path, and other AST classes; deep-copy helpers such as `Attribute` copy/assignment and generic-argument disambiguation routines; and the bulk of `accept_vis` methods that connect concrete AST node classes to the `ASTVisitor` double-dispatch interface. It therefore consumes the complete AST definitions from `rust-ast-full.h` and supplies common runtime behavior used by dumping, diagnostics, parsing, and later AST-processing code.
